untouched: Anybody watching from your own library, over your own network. That traffic never goes out over the line, so nothing here can slow it down and nothing here tries.

Everything else this machine does. lemonfiber sets limits inside its own download clients and nowhere else — it does not shape the machine's traffic, which would want privileges it should not hold and would reach applications that are none of its business.
